title: Phoenix Lights boomerang craft
summary: James Fox tells of Phoenix Lights boomerang craft, about 1997 at Phoenix, Arizona, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
plain: James Fox, a filmmaker who makes documentaries about UFOs, recalls the 1997 sightings over Phoenix, Arizona, known as the Phoenix Lights, in which many people say they saw a huge craft shaped like a boomerang. Speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, he simply calls what happened there "pretty phenomenal," and holds it up as one of the strongest mass sightings.
